Interior clear height only ≈ 1.35 rig (0.83 m): FB cannot sit visibly; fine for hop-in-hidden

wheel_split.reason: source mesh: main island 1,306,112 of 1,324,446 tris holds body, bird and all four wheels (5 tiny islands = lamp parts). Tyre inner sidewall (|z| 0.32-0.34 Meshy) is joined to axle/suspension geometry over radius < 0.22; no clean boundary. Per V-273 addendum: keep fused, WS1 uses invisible physics wheels + these hub anchors.

driver_bird.result: not cut, delivered with bird only (no _ohne_fahrer)
driver_bird.reason: the bird replaces the roof outer surface over ≈ 0.22 x 0.14 Meshy units (≈ 0.6 x 0.38 m): below the bird body there is no roof face, only the interior ceiling (y 0.27 Meshy). A plane cut (y > 0.345) leaves an open hole in the roof plus loose wing/tail fragments and foot stubs; a fix would need new cap geometry and a texture patch

seat_fit.method: seat.js (V-321) is a solid-hull test; this car has a modelled hollow interior with open windows, so the inside test does not apply (1069 of 1873 body samples read as outside)
seat_fit.note: FB seated would not fit visibly; hop-in-hidden unaffected
